seedStatus.notes: Anti-Champion 2.0 is the current model: champion stuns are intrinsic to Legendary weapon frames, not artifact mods. That principle and the removal of Radiant/Volatile-Rounds Barrier stuns are current-source verified (rule.verified=true). The exact subclass-verb -> champion-type mapping is 2023-era and NOT re-verified for MoT; those counters carry verified=false and are the step-2 verification checklist. championFrameTableAvailable=false: the weapon-frame -> champion table (which Legendary frames stun which type) does not yet exist in the component library and is the main content dependency for full champion reasoning. Surge/shield rules encode the stable directional mechanic (match element); exact magnitudes are intentionally omitted. Surge delivery changed in MoT (the fixed weekly GM surge strip was removed; surges are now activity/launch-card modifiers). Shield-matching is now gated behind the Match Game challenge modifier. Bane is a new MoT modifier category, reserved in the schema but not yet seeded (no verified bane data).

rules.subject: Barrier

counters.value: Legendary weapon frame with intrinsic Anti-Barrier stun
counters.note: MoT Anti-Champion 2.0: match a Barrier-stunning frame to the champion. Specific frame list pending the weapon-frame table (championFrameTableAvailable=false).
MoT: Radiant and Volatile Rounds NO LONGER stun Barrier. They now grant +10% damage vs Champions instead. Do not treat as a Barrier stun.
Historically intrinsic Anti-Barrier; re-verify against a MoT-current source before marking verified.
Legacy pre-MoT interaction; may be superseded by the frame-based system. Re-verify.

rules.reasoning: In Monument of Triumph (Anti-Champion 2.0), Barrier stuns are intrinsic to weapon frames: bring a Barrier-stunning Legendary frame or a confirmed anti-Barrier exotic. The pre-MoT path of stunning Barriers with Radiant or Volatile Rounds was removed; those buffs now only add champion damage, so a build relying on them will fail to stun.

rules.subject: Arc

counters.note: Matching Arc damage breaks an Arc shield efficiently with an elemental burst + area detonation on break.

rules.reasoning: Arc combatant shields take reduced damage from off-element sources and burst when hit with matching Arc damage. Under the Match Game challenge modifier this becomes decisive: non-matching damage is heavily reduced, so an Arc answer (weapon or ability) is needed to break the shield at all.

sources.title: Match Game is Still a Thing in Destiny 2, You Just Need to Find It

rules.subject: Arc

counters.note: When an Arc surge modifier is active, Arc weapons and Arc ability damage gain bonus outgoing damage. Magnitude intentionally omitted (varies).

rules.reasoning: A surge boosts outgoing damage of its element. When Arc surge is active, prioritise Arc weapons and, where the build allows, an Arc subclass to convert the surge into real damage. Note: in MoT the fixed weekly GM surge strip was removed; surges now appear as activity/launch-card modifiers rather than a guaranteed weekly element.
